title: 第十章 三剑
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕紧握寒月，狠狠的向变异体砍去，它见到林夕居然还敢主动上来顿时怒火中烧

伴随着嘶吼声，也冲向林夕，两人就这么碰撞在了一起。

随着寒月剑砍在变异体的爪子上，发出令人难以忍受的声音，撕拉一声

变异体一脚向林夕踹来，林夕顿时一惊大骂道：“还会用脚吗！”

随后便被一脚踢到了肚子上倒飞了出去

砰的一声，林夕便撞在了一颗树上，“咳”一口鲜血随着林夕的咳嗽喷出

“林夕！”孙悦张常二人均是惊呼道，随着二人的惊呼，变异体扭头看向二人

因为在它的认知中，林夕已经被打败了，唯一剩下让自己能感受到一丝威胁的就只剩这两个人了

林夕暗道糟糕，随即对着两人喊道：“快往我这边跑！”

林夕话音刚出，就见到变异体冲向两人，林夕当即站起身，强忍着疼痛，冲向两人

就在这时系统的提示音响了起来

“任务 击杀中级变异体” 、

”任务成功奖励经验值1000“

”任务成功奖励精神力开放“

”任务失败死亡“

林夕此时已经顾不上系统说了什么，一股脑地向变异体冲去。

只不过受伤的林夕还是慢了一步，只见变异体一爪子挠向孙悦

张常眼见孙悦要被打中，急忙向后一拉将孙悦挡在自己身后

林夕大喊一声：”别硬接！”

可是为时已晚，只听砰的一声，不省人事的张常便飞了出去。

林夕大骂道：“草，我看上的人，你也敢碰！”随即一个又一个冰锥向变异体打去

林夕再一次成功的吸引的变异体的注意，看着被自己打飞的人居然还能站起来攻击自己

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Xi held Han Yue tightly and slashed at the mutant. When it saw Lin Xi actually dared to come forward, it immediately became furious.

Along with the roar, he also rushed towards Lin Xi, and the two collided with each other.

As the Hanyue Sword slashed at the mutant's claws, it made an unbearable sound, and there was a tearing sound.

The mutant kicked Lin Xi, and Lin Xi was shocked and cursed: "Can you still use your feet?"

Then he was kicked in the stomach and flew out.

With a bang, Lin Xi hit a tree, and a mouthful of blood spurted out as Lin Xi coughed.

"Lin Xi!" Sun Yue and Zhang Chang both exclaimed. As they exclaimed, the mutant turned to look at them.

Because in its perception, Lin Xi has been defeated, and the only ones left to feel a hint of threat are these two people.

Lin Xi secretly thought that was bad, and then shouted to the two of them: "Run to me quickly!"

As soon as Lin Xi finished speaking, she saw the mutant rushing toward the two of them. Lin Xi immediately stood up, endured the pain, and rushed toward the two of them.

Just then the system prompt sounded.

"Mission: Kill Intermediate Mutants",

"The successful mission will reward 1000 experience points"

"Mission success rewards mental power opening"

"Mission failed and died"

At this time, Lin Xi no longer cared about what the system said and rushed towards the mutant.

However, the injured Lin Xi was still a step slower and saw the mutant scratching Sun Yue with its claws.

Seeing that Sun Yue was about to be hit, Zhang Chang hurriedly pulled Sun Yue back to block him behind him.

Lin Xi shouted: "Don't force it!"

But it was too late, only a bang was heard, and the unconscious Zhang Chang flew out.

Lin Xi cursed: "Fuck, you dare to touch the person I like!" Then one ice pick after another hit the mutant

Lin Xi once again successfully attracted the mutant's attention and saw that the person who was knocked away by him could actually stand up and attack him.
